title: Prespecified Robustness and Distribution-Shift Stress Testing
purpose: Test whether the Phase 7/7B/8 headline directions depend on one support definition, Route-B aggregation choice, biological context, missing-context pattern, or grouped split seed. Phase 9 is robustness-only and may narrow claims but may not replace the primary analysis.
headline_results_to_stress_test_not_rede: AUPRC is strongly prevalence-sensitive across factorial regimes and may move opposite to AUROC.
Pooled compound-aware validation is optimistic for joint-OOD AUROC in the locked Phase 7B analysis.
Structure-only probability skill deteriorates under joint chemical-biological shift.
HTTr-informed models attenuate the structure-only reliability loss and joint novelty interaction.
Biological-response-space novelty predicts probability error beyond model confidence.
Support-based abstention identifies elevated-risk predictions, but confidence-based abstention is more efficient.

chemical_definitions.rule: Frozen v0.2 rule: C0 if scaffold represented OR max Morgan >=0.50; C1 otherwise (unseen scaffold AND max Morgan <0.50).
C0 if max Morgan >=0.50; C1 if max Morgan <0.50.
C0 if max Morgan >=0.40; C1 if max Morgan <0.40.
C0 if max Morgan >=0.30; C1 if max Morgan <0.30.
C0 if frozen scaffold_represented_in_train=True; C1 otherwise.

biological_definitions.rule: Frozen v0.2 primary biological_state from median Route-B HTTr distance versus training q75.
Use frozen Phase-3 B_state_amended_q90 (median distance; binary q90 definition).
Use frozen Phase-3 B_state_primary_q95: B0 <= q90, BBUF q90..q95, B1 > q95; exclude BBUF from factorial contrasts.
Use frozen Phase-3 B_state_q975: B0 <= q90, BBUF q90..q97.5, B1 > q97.5; exclude BBUF.
Use frozen Phase-3 B_state_worst_q95 based on worst available context distance; exclude BBUF.

module_9A_support_definition_and_severit.factorial_cartesian_grid: All 5 chemical definitions x all 5 biological definitions = 25 prespecified support-definition combinations.
module_9A_support_definition_and_severit.support_rule: Pooled endpoint x factorial cell must contain both classes; otherwise mark unsupported. Do not merge or repair sparse cells.

module_9B_routeB_aggregation.primary: arithmetic mean of context-row raw probabilities to parent
module_9B_routeB_aggregation.sensitivity: median of the same locked context-row raw probabilities to parent
module_9B_routeB_aggregation.implementation: Outer-prediction aggregation sensitivity only. Use the exact frozen Phase-6 models, fold-specific Platt coefficients, decision thresholds and late-fusion weights. For HTTR/EARLY_FUSION, aggregate locked raw context probabilities by median, then apply the original fold-specific calibrator. For LATE_FUSION, combine the median-aggregated calibrated HTTR probability with the unchanged structure probability using the original late-fusion weight. No retuning/recalibration is allowed in this module.
module_9B_routeB_aggregation.comparison: paired mean-versus-median differences using the same labeled parents and bootstrap draws

context_specific_locked_prediction_analy.rule: Use one locked context-row prediction per parent/context. Apply the original fold-specific calibrator; construct context-specific late fusion using the original structure probability and fusion weight. Parent is the bootstrap unit.

missing_context_sensitivity.rule: Use locked parent OOF predictions; report only estimable endpoint/model/stratum results.

V4_leave_one_context_out.rule: For each held-out context, refit preprocessing, PCA, models, calibration and thresholds using only the other contexts and the unchanged Phase-6 candidate grids/tuning rules. No held-out-context outcome may influence selection. All three held-out contexts must be reported; none may be selected post hoc.
V4_leave_one_context_out.gateD_role: supportive; inability to execute leakage-safely must be reported and cannot be replaced by a post-hoc shortcut

rules: Run all four V3 split sets; never select or omit a split because of performance.
Recompute descriptor scaling, HTTr variance filtering/scaling/PCA inside each alternative outer/inner training scope.
Use the exact Phase-6 candidate grids, tuning metric, calibration method, MCC threshold grid, late-fusion weights and random-seed derivation principles.
No new model family, feature representation or tuning budget may enter V3.
Store immutable parent OOF predictions separately for each V3 split set before robustness statistics.
V3 split sets are robustness replicates, not independent biological replicates.

class_imbalance_robustness.evidence: balanced accuracy, balanced MCC, prevalence-aware AUPRC interpretation and Brier Skill Score already computed.
class_imbalance_robustness.prohibited: No synthetic resampling of any test set.

representation_sensitivity.reason: The Phase-0 protocol mentioned MACCS and pathway/latent HTTr sensitivities, but exact post-Phase-5 implementation objects were not frozen for all alternatives before primary outcome access. Any newly implemented representation sensitivity after this freeze must be labeled exploratory and may not rescue Gate D.

statistics.multiplicity: BH-FDR within each named module x metric x contrast family
statistics.across_endpoint: supportive DerSimonian-type random-effects synthesis; endpoint estimates remain visible

gate_D_claim_stability_rules.support_definition_stability: For a headline direction to be called robust, >=75% of supported 9A definition combinations must match the Phase7/7B/8 direction and no supported definition may show an FDR-significant effect in the opposite direction.
gate_D_claim_stability_rules.V3_split_stability: For a headline direction to be called split-robust, >=3 of 4 V3 split-level across-endpoint estimates must match the primary direction; if >=2 of 4 reverse direction, the claim is downgraded. A split with an opposite 95% CI excluding zero is explicitly reported.
gate_D_claim_stability_rules.aggregation_stability: Mean-to-median aggregation must not systematically reverse the headline direction. Any material reversal is reported as aggregation dependence.
gate_D_claim_stability_rules.context_stability: A context-general claim requires the same direction in at least 2 of 3 estimable contexts and no evidence that one context alone accounts for the full effect. Otherwise the claim becomes context-dependent.
gate_D_claim_stability_rules.missingness_stability: Where estimable, the key direction should be retained in both complete (3-context) and incomplete-context strata; otherwise state missing-context dependence.
gate_D_claim_stability_rules.failure_action: Reduce or qualify the manuscript claim. Never change thresholds, omit seeds, remove endpoints or retune models.

prohibited_actions: No replacement of Phase7/7B/8 primary results by a more favorable Phase9 variant.
No endpoint removal based on Phase9 performance.
No model, feature, calibration, threshold or fusion-weight retuning based on observed Phase9 test results.
No treating contexts, folds or V3 seeds as independent biological replicates.
No presenting post-outcome representation experiments as prespecified confirmatory robustness.
execution_order: P9A support-definition/severity robustness on immutable OOF predictions
P9D four V3 full retraining robustness
Gate D synthesis and claim classification
